description: Registers a local stdio MCP server proxying arbitrary Jira/Confluence/JSM MCP tools to Atlassian's hosted MCP server, authenticated with a static personal API token or service-account key -- no OAuth. Requires an org admin to have enabled token-based MCP auth.

outputs.description: No asset -- registers a Dagster resource (a stdio MCP server) for other components to reference via server_resource_key.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key other components reference via server_resource_key.

auth_mode.label: Auth Mode
auth_mode.description: 'personal_api_token': Authorization: Basic base64(email:api_token), acting as that person. 'service_account': Authorization: Bearer <key>, acting as a service account. Both require an org admin to have enabled token-based MCP auth.

atlassian_email_env_var.label: Atlassian Email Env Var
atlassian_email_env_var.description: auth_mode='personal_api_token': env var holding the token owner's Atlassian account email.

atlassian_api_token_env_var.label: Atlassian Api Token Env Var
atlassian_api_token_env_var.description: auth_mode='personal_api_token': env var holding the personal API token (id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens).

atlassian_service_account_key_env_var.label: Atlassian Service Account Key Env Var
atlassian_service_account_key_env_var.description: auth_mode='service_account': env var holding the service-account API key.

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Optional hard allow-list of Atlassian MCP tool names. Default: every tool your granted apps/scopes expose.

max_requests_per_second.label: Max Requests Per Second
max_requests_per_second.description: Shared by every tool call this server process makes.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retries on a transient error before returning {'error': ...} to the agent.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: Free-text usage guidance for this server -- read by the litellm/openai/anthropic/gemini agent components and appended to their system prompt under a heading with this resource's name, so every agent referencing it via server_resource_key gets the same guidance with no copy-paste.
